adds.title: Gabon government bill to decriminalise same-sex sexual activity (2020)
adds.summary: On 23 June 2020 Gabon's lower house voted 48 in favour, 24 against with 25 abstentions to revise the 2019 law to decriminalise sexual relations between people of the same sex, removing punishment of up to six months imprisonment and a 5 million FCFA fine, while same-sex marriage remained not allowed.

adds.title: Constitution of Gabon adopted by national referendum November 2024
adds.summary: In Gabon same-sex relations were decriminalised in 2020, same-sex marriage remains prohibited, and LGBTQIA+ people face societal stigmatization.
